## Checklist

- [ ] Only synthetic data; new data files are covered by a `SYNTHETIC_MANIFEST.json`.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings with passwords or `.env` files.
- [ ] Third-party GitHub Actions are pinned to a full commit SHA (version in a comment).
- [ ] Versions named in docs and examples match the compatibility table in the README.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under "Unreleased" for a user-visible change.

Security issues: please use a private security advisory instead of a pull request (SECURITY.md).
